question: Related Questions Q. کیا ہم گھر میں کسی بھی وقت جھاڑو لگاسکتے ہیں؟ میں نے سنا ہے کہ عصر کے بعد جھاڑو سے صفائی نہیں کرنی چاہئے؟کیا کوئی ایسی بات ہے؟براہ کرم، وضاحت کریں۔ 4978 views Q. Assalamu alaikum (1) i want to know about the explanation of my dream i so many times so that i was flying in the sky like an air-plane in the air (2) i also saw many times that i am unwillingly going upwards (as a gass filled balloon touches the roof if it is unthreaded in a room) and trying to come to the ground and asking others to help me. please help me know the ta-abeer 1399 views Q. Salaam! I believe that niqab is farz. I want to wear it but since I will be the only one doing it in my close surrounding, I do not feel ready to observe niqab during family gatherings. People have been telling me that either you wear niqab all the time or you do not wear it at all. So I would like to know whether it permissible to wear niqab only while going out in the streets or other public places (where there are non muslims strangers) and uncover my face in front of non-mehram relatives (cousins and brothers in law)? I mean is it ok to do it sometimes rather than not doing it at all? 2654 views Q. Is it ok to do study after Asar salah? 7842 views Q. Asalamu 'alaikum, Firstly, jazak Allah for all of the questions you have answered for me. I want to remove the thought of this dream that I had a few weeks ago. At sunrise time, I went to sleep and I had this dream- before I went to sleep, I think I made du'a to Allah and said the shahadah before sleeping. I also think I had started writing a hamd (poem) and the night before I had finished, al hamdu lillah, a hamd on Asma ul husna. So I dreamt of 4 particular things. I don't know the order, but I remember seeing a lecturer talk about something to do with Islam, then all of the sudden I looked out of the window to see a beautiful scene of snow in my garden with the orangy-red night sky. Then I remember being on my prayer mat, facing the qiblah and making du'aa unto Allah. I remember supplicating Ya Mu'min (WAllahu 'alam) and I then saw a tree next to me (it was black and I think it had no leaves), it seemed like it was doing ruku' (WAllahu 'alam) and coming towards me, I kept on moving my head away and was still doing the du'aa. I woke up still mumbling the du'a. What could this mean? Jazak Allahu Khair for your continued patience. Ma' salam. 1856 views Q. My Question ? 1) One of my sister saw in her dream that my deceased mother stating - "Please provide me one bulb there is too much dark here, by listening this my sister told that I will get the bulb and walk towards a street pole to take a bulb from that and then her 6 years old son ran by saying that he will get it and got accident from the coming truck and found alive luckily after accident." 2) In her other dream she saw - ?I have given some money to my sister and my mother asked & took Rs.250/- from her hand and went away? 3) 2 years back she saw "Please remove this spider net and clean it, there is too much dust here? 4) She also saw in her dream - ?my mother standing very sadly in our house? Mufti sab kindly give the tabeer/guidance of these dreams. 1682 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 45777 Country: FR Title: valid ghusal Question: Here a married woman has habit of eating nails up to that extent even blood comes out of fingers. She applied bitter medicines but in vain. Can she use false nails? Please reply in the light of hadith with false nails her ghusl would be valid or invalid. The false nails can be worn or not? What she can do? Please reply. Answer ID: 45777 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 962/B-200/TB=1434) It is an ordinary habit and one can get rid of it easily or with a bit difficulty. If false nails are fixed which may be removed at the time of wudhu and ghusl then it shall be necessary to remove them for wudhu and ghusl. However, it shall not be allowed to wear false nails due to the said excuse. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
